name: How To Ruin Geometry Dash
description: A parody mod that monetizes every button. Ubisoft has 'acquired' GD. All money is fictional wallet credit. Nothing is real, nothing touches GD servers.

enable-intro.name: Play Ubisoft intro
enable-intro.description: Plays the Ubisoft logo intro once per game launch, before the main menu. Tap to skip.

enable-ubisoft-notice.name: Show Ubisoft acquisition notice
enable-ubisoft-notice.description: Shows the 'UBISOFT HAS ACQUIRED GEOMETRY DASH!' announcement once per game launch.

ubisoft-branding.name: Ubisoft corporate terminology
ubisoft-branding.description: Uses corporate wording (Ubisoft Credits, Player Engagement Energy, Promotional Opportunities...). Labels only: nothing else changes.

enable-ads.name: Enable advertisements
enable-ads.description: Forced and banner ads. Rewarded ads are always optional.

enable-energy.name: Enable energy
enable-energy.description: On: energy is burned when you play and what you burn sets your payout. Off: no limits, but payouts are reduced (see 'Payout when energy is off').

energy-per-level.name: Energy per level
energy-per-level.description: Energy burned when a level starts. 2 pays exactly the listed reward; each point more or less changes the payout by 25% (times the multiplier below).

energy-per-attempt.name: Energy per attempt
energy-per-attempt.description: Extra energy burned on every attempt. Burned energy counts towards the payout.

energy-regen-seconds.name: Seconds per energy
energy-regen-seconds.description: Seconds needed to regenerate one point of energy.

energy-reward-multiplier.name: Energy reward multiplier
energy-reward-multiplier.description: Scales how strongly burned energy changes the payout (1.0 = +/-25% per point).

energy-disabled-percent.name: Payout when energy is off
energy-disabled-percent.description: Percent of the normal payout you receive when energy is disabled.

sub-period-minutes.name: Subscription 'month' length (real minutes)
sub-period-minutes.description: How long one simulated month lasts before auto-renew.

pack-menu-button.name: Show 2.21 Pack button
pack-menu-button.description: Shows the Geometry Dash 2.21 Pack button on the main menu (the pack is always reachable from the Shop too).

reset-mod-data.name: Reset mod data
reset-mod-data.description: Erases only this mod's saved data (wallet, purchases, stats...). Asks for confirmation first. Never touches Geometry Dash's own data.

give-all-money.name: Maximum cash
give-all-money.description: Sets the mod's fictional wallet to $2,147,483,647.00. Fictional credit only.
